data.html_title: Accessible vs Inclusive Design: Key Differences and Why Both Matter
data.html_description: Understand the real difference between accessible and inclusive design — what separates them, where they overlap, and how to apply both to create better products for everyone.
data.description: There's a mistake that shows up constantly in design conversations: using "accessible" and "inclusive" as if they mean the same thing. They don't.
